function.name: send_info_email
function.description: Email information to the address already on the verified caller's account. Call it after the caller said yes to having it emailed. Never takes an address. Its result is a sentence that has already been spoken to the caller.

topic.description: document_checklist for the documents a claim still needs and how to send them; claim_summary for the status of every claim; how_to_start_claim for the steps to start a new claim.

messages.content: I wasn't able to send that email just now. You can find the same information at observeinsurance dot com slash claims, or I can have a representative send it. Which would you prefer?
